rationale: E2 confirmed the central reach-fidelity account; F3 remains article-central and regression has opposite package signs at seeds 0 and 1.

evaluation.metric: record-level foreground MSE with complete-v2 corroborating metrics
evaluation.effect_convention: spatial error minus temporal error; positive favors temporal packaging

primary_estimand: seed-specific difference in temporal-package advantage between regression and diffusion; negative means regression shifts toward spatial packaging
primary_rule: Report all three seed-specific package effects and interactions. A consistent head shift is supported only if the interaction is negative at all three seeds; do not call regression equivalent when its seed effects differ in sign.

e4b_training_seed_trigger.fires_if: After E4a, regression package effects contain both a value >= +0.005 and a value <= -0.005, or their sample standard deviation exceeds 0.010.
e4b_training_seed_trigger.meaning: material training-seed heterogeneity, independent of clip-bootstrap evaluation uncertainty
e4b_training_seed_trigger.budget_rule: E4b replaces or reduces E6, E8c or E9 and is never additive or reserve-funded

budget.accounting: wall-clock project GPU ownership including training, evaluation, uploads, failures and retries

compatibility.regime: legacy B16x30k scientific kernel wrapped by H3b provenance-v2
compatibility.reason: Changing batch/LR/updates to fill VRAM would create a new optimizer regime and invalidate completion of the legacy factorial.
